title: The world's gold, melted into a cube, vs. an Olympic pool (meters)

source.name: How Much Gold Has Been Mined (gold cube calculation)

notes: The 22.3-meter side length is the widely cited calculation of melting the ~216,265-tonne above-ground gold stock (density 19.32 g/cm^3) into a single cube; Olympic pool length (50m) is the standard FINA competition length, used only as a familiar scale reference.
